He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Minnesota Golden Gophers men's basketball|Minnesota Golden Gophers]].{{Cite web|title=Amir Coffey – Men's Basketball|url=https://gophersports.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/amir-coffey/14460|access-date=September 14, 2020|website=University of Minnesota Athletics|language=en}} ==High school career== Attending [[Hopkins High School]] in [[Minnetonka, Minnesota]],{{Cite web|title=Amir Coffey, Los Angeles Clippers, Shooting Guard|url=https://247sports.com/player/amir-coffey-25282/|access-date=September 14, 2020|website=247Sports|language=en-US}} Coffey received [[Minnesota Mr. Basketball]] honors as a senior,{{Cite news |last=Stavenhagen |first=Cody |date=March 14, 2016 |title=Hopkins' Amir Coffey named Mr. Basketball |work=Star Tribune |url=https://www.startribune.com/hopkins-amir-coffey-named-mr-basketball/372029761 |access-date=November 15, 2023}} while earning [[Associated Press]] State Player of the Year{{Cite news |date=March 15, 2016 |title=Amir Coffey named AP Player of the Year for boys basketball |language=en |work=USA Today |url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/nba/2016/03/15/amir-coffey-named-ap-player-of-the-year-for-boys-basketball/81837864/ |access-date=July 19, 2017}} and Star Tribune Metro Player of the Year distinction.{{Cite news|url=http://www.startribune.com/coffey-takes-accolades-hungers-for-a-title/371342361/|title=Coffey takes accolades, hungers for a title|work=Star Tribune|access-date=July 19, 2017}} He averaged 19.9 points during his senior season (2015–16). A four-star recruit and ranked 32nd overall in [[ESPN]]’s top 100 for the class of 2016,{{Cite web |title=Amir Coffey – Basketball Recruiting – Player Profiles – ESPN |url=https://www.espn.com/college-sports/basketball/recruiting/player/_/id/170379 |access-date=November 15, 2023 |website=ESPN.com}} Coffey announced his decision to play college basketball at [[Minnesota Golden Gophers men's basketball|Minnesota]] in September 2015.{{Cite news |last=Rayno |first=Amelia |date=September 22, 2015 |title=Hopkins star Amir Coffey picks Gophers |work=Star Tribune |url=https://www.startribune.com/amir-coffey-hopkins-star-picks-minnesota/328551541 |access-date=November 15, 2023}} He scored seven points to go along with two assists and two rebounds at the 2016 [[Jordan Brand Classic]].{{Cite web|url=http://jordanbrandclassic.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/01/Jordan-Classic-National-Box-Score.pdf|title=Official Basketball Box Score – Game Totals – Final Statistics East Team vs West Team|website=jordanbrandclassic.com|access-date=July 19, 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161228103814/http://jordanbrandclassic.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/01/Jordan-Classic-National-Box-Score.pdf|archive-date=December 28, 2016|url-status=dead}} ==College career== He had an immediate impact on the Minnesota Golden Gophers, finishing his freshman year as the team’s second-leading scorer (12.2 ppg) and second-leading assist man at 3.1 per game,{{Cite news |last=Hamilton |first=Brian |date=May 4, 2017 |title=Is Minnesota's Amir Coffey ready for a sophomore leap? |work=SI.com |url=https://www.si.com/college/2017/05/04/minnesota-gophers-basketball-pitino-coffey |access-date=November 15, 2023}} earning [[Big Ten Conference]] All-Freshman Team honors.{{Cite news |title=Five Gophers Receive All-Big Ten Honors |work=gophersports.com |url=http://www.gophersports.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/030617aaa.html |url-status=dead |access-date=July 19, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180626141648/http://www.gophersports.com/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/030617aaa.html |archive-date=June 26, 2018}} In his junior season, he was named by coaches and media to the [[List of All-Big Ten Conference men's basketball teams|All-Big Ten]] third team. ==Professional career== ===Los Angeles Clippers (2019–2025)=== After going undrafted in the [[2019 NBA draft]], Coffey signed a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Los Angeles Clippers]].{{cite news|title=Amir Coffey signs with the Clippers|url=https://www.thedailygopher.com/2019/6/22/18714019/amir-coffey-signs-with-the-clippers|website=TheDailyGopher.com|date=June 22, 2019|access-date=June 22, 2019}}{{cite web |last=Ramirez |first=Miguel |date=July 9, 2019 |title=L.A. Clippers Sign Amir Coffey |url=https://www.nba.com/clippers/la-clippers-sign-amir-coffey |access-date=July 10, 2019 |website=NBA.com}} On August 14, 2020, he scored a season-high 21 points, along with four steals, in a 107–103 overtime win over the [[2019–20 Oklahoma City Thunder season|Oklahoma City Thunder]].{{Cite web |date=August 14, 2020 |title=Mann leads Clippers over Thunder as stars rest for playoffs |url=https://www.nba.com/game/0021901317 |access-date=April 1, 2022 |website=NBA.com}} Coffey made 18 appearances (including one start) for the Clippers during his rookie campaign, posting averages of 3.2 points, 0.9 rebounds, and 0.8 assists.{{Cite web|title=Amir Coffey 2019-20 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/4066387/type/nba/year/2020|access-date=April 4, 2026|website=espn.com|language=en}} On February 15, 2021, Coffey scored a season-high 15 points in a 125–118 win over the [[2020–21 Miami Heat season|Miami Heat]].{{Cite web |title=Morris comes up big in Clippers' 125-118 win over Heat |url=https://www.nba.com/game/0022000425 |access-date=April 1, 2022 |website=NBA}} He made 44 total appearances for Los Angeles in the [[2020–21 NBA season]], averaging 3.2 points, 1.0 rebound, and 0.5 assists.{{Cite web|title=Amir Coffey 2020-21 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/4066387/type/nba/year/2021|access-date=April 4, 2026|website=espn.com|language=en}} On September 27, 2021, Coffey signed another two-way contract with the Clippers.{{cite tweet|author=LA Clippers|number=1442522813173092365|title=Ready to put in work.|user=LAClippers|date=September 27, 2021|access-date=October 3, 2021}} On March 26, 2022, his deal was converted into a standard contract.{{cite web|first=Andrew|last=Greif|title=Clippers promote Amir Coffey, who is eligible for postseason|url=https://www.latimes.com/sports/clippers/story/2022-03-26/clippers-roster-moves-amir-coffey-promoted-semi-ojeleye-waived|website=Los Angeles Times|date=March 27, 2022|access-date=March 27, 2022}} On April 1, Coffey logged a career-high 32 points, alongside seven assists and four steals, in a 153–119 blowout win over the [[2021–22 Milwaukee Bucks season|Milwaukee Bucks]].{{Cite web |title=Clippers rip Bucks 153-119 as both teams rest top players |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/recap?gameId=401360975 |access-date=April 1, 2022 |website=ESPN}} On April 10, Coffey raised his career-high to 35 points in a 138–88 win against the [[2021–22 Oklahoma City Thunder season|Thunder]].{{Cite web |title=Thunder vs. Clippers - Box Score - April 10, 2022 - ESPN |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/boxscore/_/gameId/401361041 |access-date=2022-04-11 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} Coffey made 69 appearances (including 30 starts) for the Clippers during the [[2021–22 NBA season]], logging averages of 9.0 points, 2.9 rebounds, and 1.8 assists.{{Cite web|title=Amir Coffey 2021-22 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/4066387/type/nba/year/2022|access-date=April 4, 2026|website=espn.com|language=en}} On July 6, 2022, Coffey re-signed with the Clippers on a three-year, $11 million contract.{{Cite web |date=July 6, 2022 |title=LA Clippers Re-sign Amir Coffey |url=https://www.nba.com/clippers/news/la-clippers-re-sign-amir-coffey |access-date=July 10, 2022 |website=NBA}}{{Cite web |last=Murray |first=Law |date=July 1, 2022 |title=Amir Coffey will re-sign with Clippers to be their essential luxury … again |url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/3394083/2022/06/30/clippers-amir-coffey-deal/ |access-date=July 10, 2022 |website=The Athletic}} He played in 50 contests (starting nine) for the Clippers in the [[2022–23 NBA season|2022–23 season]], averaging 3.4 points, 1.1 rebounds, and 1.1 assists.{{Cite web|title=Amir Coffey 2022-23 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/4066387/type/nba/year/2023|access-date=April 4, 2026|website=espn.com|language=en}} Coffey made 70 appearances (including 13 starts) for Los Angeles during the [[2023–24 NBA season|2023–24 season]], recording averages of 6.6 points, 2.1 rebounds, and 1.1 assists.{{Cite web|title=Amir Coffey 2023-24 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/4066387/type/nba/year/2024|access-date=April 4, 2026|website=espn.com|language=en}} He made 72 appearances (starting another 13 games) for the Clippers during the [[2024–25 NBA season|2024–25 season]], compiling averages of 9.7 points, 2.2 rebounds, and 1.1 assists.{{Cite web|title=Amir Coffey 2024-25 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/4066387/type/nba/year/2025|access-date=April 4, 2026|website=espn.com|language=en}} ===Milwaukee Bucks (2025–2026)=== On August 20, 2025, Coffey signed with the [[Milwaukee Bucks]].{{cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/bucks/news/milwaukee-bucks-sign-amir-coffey|title=Milwaukee Bucks Sign Amir Coffey|work=NBA.com|date=August 20, 2025|accessdate=February 6, 2026}} Coffey made 30 appearances (including two starts) for Milwaukee in the [[2025–26 NBA season|2025–26 season]], averaging 2.4 points, 0.9 rebounds, and 0.4 assists.{{Cite web|title=Amir Coffey 2025-26 Stats per Game|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/gamelog/_/id/4066387/type/nba/year/2026|access-date=April 4, 2026|website=espn.com|language=en}} ===Phoenix Suns (2026)=== On February 5, 2026, Coffey was traded to the [[Phoenix Suns]] in a three-team trade involving the [[Chicago Bulls]].{{Cite web |title=Milwaukee Bucks Acquire Ousmane Dieng In Three-Team Trade |url=https://www.nba.com/bucks/news/milwaukee-bucks-acquire-ousmane-dieng-in-three-team-trade |access-date=2026-02-06|date=2026-02-05 |website=bucks.com |language=en}} Coffey played in 16 contests (including one start) for Phoenix, averaging 4.8 points, 1.9 rebounds, and 1.0 assist. === Hapoel Tel Aviv (2026–present) === On July 9, 2026, Coffey signed with [[Hapoel Tel Aviv B.C.|Hapoel Tel Aviv]] of the Israeli [[Israeli Basketball Premier League|Israeli Premier League]] and the [[EuroLeague]].{{Cite web |last=reefg@hapoebc.com |date=2026-07-09 |title=Welcome, Amir
